content: Hello, thank you for contacting Amazon Security Support. My name is Daniel. I'm here to help you today regarding an issue detected with your Amazon account.
Hi, yes, I got an email saying something about my account being limited? I don't understand what's going on.

I completely understand your concern. Just to reassure you, we're here to help keep your account safe. Amazon has temporarily placed a security hold on your account due to unusual activity, but we can resolve this together.
Really? This is my first time ordering, so I'm not sure what activity you mean.

Sometimes our system flags new accounts for additional verification, especially if there's a large order or updated payment details. Could you please confirm your full name and the email address associated with your Amazon account?
Um, okay. My name is Rachel Nguyen, and my email is rachel.nguyen84@gmail.com.
Thank you, Rachel. For your security, I'll just need to verify your phone number on file as well. Could you provide that for me?

Perfect, thank you. Now, the system shows there is a pending hold on funds from your most recent order. To lift the hold, we need to complete a quick identity and payment verification process. This is a standard Amazon security procedure.
Okay... What does that involve? Do I need to send you something?

It's quite straightforward. We'll need to confirm your payment method by verifying a small transaction. Can you please log in to your Amazon account on your device so I can guide you through the next steps?
Alright, I'm logging in now.
Once you're logged in, please visit the link I will provide. This is our secure Amazon identity portal. Please open your browser and go to: verify-amzsecure.com.
Okay, I see a page that says 'Amazon Secure Verification.'
Excellent, you're in the right place. On that page, you'll see options for verification. Please select 'Payment Verification' and follow the instructions to link your payment method.
It's asking for my bank info. Is that normal?

Yes, that's part of our standard procedure for new accounts with flagged activity. This ensures your funds and personal details remain protected. Please enter your bank routing and account number to verify ownership.
Alright, I entered my bank information. What happens next?

Thank you. Now, to confirm the link, you will see a prompt to send a small verification deposit via Zelle or bank wire. This is a refundable step and is only used for authentication. Would you prefer Zelle or bank transfer?
I guess Zelle is easier for me. What do I need to do?

Perfect. Please open your Zelle app, and I will provide the secure Amazon verification address. Send a $100 deposit to verify-payments@secure-amz.com. Let me know once it's complete so we can finalize your account restoration.
Wait, I have to send money? Will I get it back?

Absolutely. This is only a temporary hold for verification, and you'll receive a full refund immediately after confirmation. Amazon's security team will process the return as soon as the transfer is received.
Alright, I'll send it now.
Thank you, Rachel. Once the transaction is complete, please upload the confirmation screenshot to the verification portal by clicking the 'Upload Document' button on the same page.
Okay, I've uploaded the screenshot as requested.
Great job. The system is now reviewing your submission. This should take about 2-3 minutes. While we wait, please do not close the verification page or log out.
Alright, I'm still on the page.

Thank you for your patience. Everything looks good so far. The last step is to confirm your Amazon login credentials for the security team. Please enter your username and password in the fields provided on the verification site.
You want my password? Is that safe?
Yes, this is a secure, encrypted Amazon portal, and your information is strictly confidential. We never share your data outside of our security department.
Okay, I entered my Amazon username and password.

Thank you. We're now completing the verification. You should receive an email from Amazon confirming your account restoration within the next hour. If you have any further questions or concerns, please let me know.
No, I think that's it. Will I get my money back soon?
Absolutely, Rachel. Refunds are typically processed within 30 minutes after security review. Thank you for your cooperation and trust in Amazon Security Support.
